units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 23:2">Targ. Gen. XXIII, 2</cite>; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="B00778"><he>בָּכֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 5b:14">Ber. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>לההוא שופרא</he> … <he>קא בכינא</he> I cry over that beauty that it should rot in the ground.
<cite ref="Berakhot 5b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>אמאי קבכית</he> why criest thou? <cite ref="Berakhot 5b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>דהוה קא בכי</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) that he was crying.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:52">Lam. R. to I, 17</cite> <he>בָּכְיָה סלקא בָּכְיָה נחתא</he> weeping she (Israel) goes up (to the ruins of Jerusalem), weeping she goes down.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 2:1:17">Y. Yoma II, 39ᵈ</cite> top <he>שרון … בָּכְיִין</he> all the people began to cry.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:8:5">Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בכי בעיינוי</he> blear-eyed.—

<cite ref="Taanit 5b">Taan. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>וכי בכדי בכו בָּכַיָּיא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ספדו</he>) is it for naught the weepers wept? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:4">Gen. R. s. 68</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00778">next w.</cite>; a. fr.
